title: Diagnose a Failing Import
prompt: Given a small expense-import program and a repeatable exception, write a debugging record containing reproduction, stack-trace interpretation, one hypothesis, experiment, repair, and regression checks.
successCriteria: The first wrong state is distinguished from the final symptom.
Only one hypothesis is tested in the experiment.
Verification includes the original failure and at least two nearby cases.
hints: Begin with the smallest model or function that can demonstrate: The first wrong state is distinguished from the final symptom.
Use an executable example or focused check to verify: Only one hypothesis is tested in the experiment.

starterCode.code:
data class DebugRecord(
    val reproduction: String,
    val hypothesis: String,
    val evidence: String,
    val verification: List<String>,
)

solutionOutline: Implement and explain how the solution ensures: The first wrong state is distinguished from the final symptom.
Implement and explain how the solution ensures: Only one hypothesis is tested in the experiment.
Implement and explain how the solution ensures: Verification includes the original failure and at least two nearby cases.
verification: Run a focused check proving that the first wrong state is distinguished from the final symptom.
Run a focused check proving that only one hypothesis is tested in the experiment.
Run a focused check proving that verification includes the original failure and at least two nearby cases.
